note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): Bank of Maldives, State Bank of India's Maldives branch and the Commercial Bank of Maldives; the bank's own site answered with a bot check on 2026-10-29, and only the Bank of Maldives' schedule, as the Maldives Monetary Authority publishes it, was read again this time, for want of the research's budget. The Bank of Maldives' schedule of charges and fees (65th edition, effective 5 October 2026), its card services, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the Classic alone): its Classic (also sold as Standard or Green), Gold, Platinum and Infinite or World credit cards, each in rufiyaa and in US dollars, with their joining fee (written as the issue fee: 200, 500, 900 and 1,350 rufiyaa; 15, 30, 60 and 90 dollars) and annual fee (450, 800, 1,500 and 2,250 rufiyaa; 35, 55, 100 and 150 dollars); interest on a rolled-over balance of 2.85%, 2.65%, 2.5% and 2% a month; a cash advance fee of 10%, at least 10 dollars (or its equivalent in rufiyaa, a floor written on the dollar cards only); an over-limit fee and a past-due fee each of 65 rufiyaa or 5 dollars. A cross-border transaction carries a fee of up to 10% where it is in a currency other than the dollar or on a card funded in rufiyaa (up to 30% at selected merchants), written as 10%. The corporate cards aren't written. The schedule states no minimum payment or grace period. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): no bank was added. Maldives Islamic Bank's list of bank charges (effective 24 September 2026) prices debit cards only; the Commercial Bank of Maldives' and State Bank of India's Maldives sites didn't answer (2026-10-30). Wave 5 (2026-10-30), minimum payments: No minimum payment is published for Bank of Maldives' cards; tried: its schedule as filed with the Maldives Monetary Authority (no minimum), its own site (Cloudflare, refused), a web search (nothing from the bank), and archive.org (a 2025 snapshot of its card page exists, but web.archive.org is refused by this research's network).
